ingredients: cooked rice; carrot; peas; spring onion; soy sauce; garlic; oil
instructions: Dice the carrot and chop the spring onion. | Stir-fry garlic and carrot in a little oil. | Add peas and cooked rice. | Add soy sauce and spring onion; stir-fry until hot.

ingredients: pasta; tomatoes; garlic; olive oil; basil; salt; black pepper
instructions: Boil pasta until tender, then drain. | Cook chopped garlic and tomatoes in olive oil. | Season with salt and pepper. | Toss pasta with the sauce and basil.

ingredients: carrot; potato; onion; peas; vegetable stock; garlic; salt; black pepper
instructions: Chop the vegetables into small pieces. | Soften onion and garlic in a pot. | Add vegetables and stock. | Simmer until the vegetables are tender; season to taste.

ingredients: flour; milk; egg; baking powder; sugar; butter
instructions: Whisk flour, baking powder, and sugar. | Mix in milk and egg until just combined. | Cook small portions on a lightly buttered pan. | Flip when bubbles appear and cook through.

ingredients: chicken breast; olive oil; lemon; garlic; paprika; salt; black pepper
instructions: Mix oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper. | Coat the chicken with the marinade. | Cook on a grill pan until fully cooked throughout. | Rest briefly before slicing.

ingredients: lettuce; cucumber; tomato; carrot; lemon juice; olive oil; salt
instructions: Wash and dry the vegetables. | Slice cucumber and tomato; grate carrot. | Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, and salt. | Toss everything together just before serving.

ingredients: pizza dough; tomato sauce; mozzarella; basil; olive oil
instructions: Heat the oven according to the dough instructions. | Spread tomato sauce over the dough. | Add mozzarella and a little olive oil. | Bake until the crust is browned and cheese is melted; add basil.

ingredients: toor dal; onion; tomato; garlic; cumin; turmeric; ghee or oil; salt
instructions: Rinse and cook the dal with turmeric until soft. | Cook onion, garlic, and tomato in ghee or oil. | Add cumin and the cooked dal. | Simmer with water to the desired consistency and season.

ingredients: paneer; tomatoes; onion; ginger; garlic; cream; butter; garam masala
instructions: Cook onion, ginger, garlic, and tomatoes until soft. | Blend the mixture into a smooth sauce. | Simmer with butter and garam masala. | Add paneer and cream; heat gently until warmed through.

ingredients: chickpeas; onion; tomato; ginger; garlic; cumin; coriander powder; garam masala
instructions: Cook onion, ginger, and garlic until softened. | Add tomato and spices; cook into a thick masala. | Add cooked chickpeas and a little water. | Simmer for 10–15 minutes and adjust seasoning.

ingredients: basmati rice; carrot; peas; potato; onion; yogurt; biryani spices; mint
instructions: Rinse and partially cook the rice. | Cook onion and vegetables with spices and yogurt. | Layer rice over the vegetables with mint. | Cover and cook on low heat until the rice is tender.

ingredients: dosa batter; potato; onion; mustard seeds; curry leaves; turmeric; oil
instructions: Boil and mash the potatoes. | Cook onion, mustard seeds, curry leaves, and turmeric; mix with potato. | Spread dosa batter thinly on a hot pan. | Cook until crisp, add potato filling, and fold.

ingredients: basmati rice; carrot; peas; beans; onion; ginger; whole spices; oil
instructions: Rinse the rice and chop the vegetables. | Sauté onion, ginger, and whole spices. | Add vegetables and rice; stir gently. | Add water and cook covered until rice is tender.

ingredients: eggs; onion; bell pepper; tomato; salt; black pepper; oil
instructions: Beat eggs with salt and pepper. | Chop the vegetables and mix them into the eggs. | Pour into a lightly oiled pan. | Cook until set, turning carefully if needed.

ingredients: eggs; milk; butter; salt; black pepper
instructions: Beat eggs with a splash of milk and seasoning. | Melt butter over low heat. | Add eggs and stir gently until softly set. | Remove from heat and serve promptly.

ingredients: chicken; noodles; carrot; celery; onion; chicken stock; salt; black pepper
instructions: Cook onion, carrot, and celery in a pot. | Add stock and chicken; simmer until chicken is cooked. | Remove and shred the chicken, then return it to the pot. | Add noodles and cook until tender.

ingredients: ramen noodles; broth; soy sauce; mushrooms; spring onion; egg; spinach
instructions: Heat the broth with soy sauce and mushrooms. | Cook noodles according to the packet instructions. | Place noodles in a bowl and pour over the hot broth. | Add cooked egg, spinach, and spring onion.

ingredients: dumpling wrappers; cabbage; carrot; spring onion; ginger; soy sauce
instructions: Finely chop cabbage, carrot, spring onion, and ginger. | Mix with a little soy sauce. | Fill and seal the wrappers with water along the edges. | Steam until the filling is cooked and wrappers are tender.

ingredients: sushi rice; nori; cucumber; avocado; rice vinegar; sugar; salt
instructions: Cook sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt. | Place nori on a rolling mat and spread rice evenly. | Add cucumber and avocado in a line. | Roll tightly and slice with a damp knife.

ingredients: rice; spinach; carrot; mushrooms; egg; gochujang; soy sauce; sesame oil
instructions: Cook rice and prepare vegetables separately. | Sauté mushrooms and carrot; wilt spinach. | Arrange rice and vegetables in a bowl. | Add egg and serve with gochujang, soy sauce, and sesame oil.

ingredients: rice noodles; tofu; bean sprouts; carrot; lime; soy sauce; peanuts
instructions: Soak or cook rice noodles as directed. | Stir-fry tofu and carrot until heated through. | Add noodles and soy sauce; toss together. | Finish with bean sprouts, lime, and crushed peanuts.

ingredients: rice noodles; broth; ginger; onion; bean sprouts; basil; lime
instructions: Heat broth with ginger and onion to infuse it. | Cook rice noodles separately. | Place noodles in a bowl and pour in hot broth. | Serve with bean sprouts, basil, and lime.

ingredients: tortillas; black beans; tomato; lettuce; avocado; lime; cumin
instructions: Warm the beans with cumin and a little water. | Chop tomato, lettuce, and avocado. | Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. | Fill tortillas with beans and vegetables; finish with lime.

ingredients: avocado; lime juice; tomato; onion; cilantro; salt
instructions: Mash avocado in a bowl. | Fold in finely chopped tomato, onion, and cilantro. | Add lime juice and salt. | Serve fresh.

ingredients: rice; black beans; corn; tomato; lettuce; avocado; lime
instructions: Cook rice and warm the beans and corn. | Chop tomato, lettuce, and avocado. | Arrange rice, beans, corn, and vegetables in a bowl. | Add lime juice and preferred toppings.

ingredients: soaked chickpeas; onion; garlic; parsley; cumin; coriander; flour
instructions: Drain soaked chickpeas well. | Pulse chickpeas with onion, garlic, herbs, and spices. | Mix in a little flour to help bind the mixture. | Shape and bake or pan-cook until browned and cooked through.

ingredients: cooked chickpeas; tahini; lemon juice; garlic; olive oil; salt
instructions: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and garlic. | Add cold water gradually until smooth. | Season with salt. | Serve with a little olive oil.

ingredients: eggs; tomatoes; bell pepper; onion; garlic; paprika; cumin
instructions: Cook onion, bell pepper, and garlic until softened. | Add tomatoes and spices; simmer until thick. | Make small wells in the sauce and add eggs. | Cover and cook until the eggs reach your preferred doneness.

ingredients: chickpeas; carrot; potato; tomato; onion; cumin; cinnamon; vegetable stock
instructions: Sauté onion with cumin and a small pinch of cinnamon. | Add chopped vegetables, chickpeas, tomato, and stock. | Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender. | Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

ingredients: rice; tomatoes; red bell pepper; onion; garlic; ginger; thyme; stock
instructions: Blend tomatoes and red bell pepper into a sauce. | Cook onion, garlic, and ginger, then add the sauce and spices. | Stir in rinsed rice and stock. | Cover and cook gently until the rice is tender, checking liquid as needed.

ingredients: tomato; cucumber; red onion; olives; feta; olive oil; oregano
instructions: Chop tomato, cucumber, and red onion. | Combine with olives and feta. | Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle oregano. | Toss gently and serve.

ingredients: pasta; basil; garlic; parmesan; olive oil; pine nuts
instructions: Boil pasta and reserve a little pasta water. | Blend basil, garlic, parmesan, pine nuts, and olive oil. | Toss hot pasta with pesto and a splash of pasta water. | Serve immediately.

ingredients: mushrooms; onion; garlic; vegetable stock; milk or cream; butter; black pepper
instructions: Slice mushrooms and chop onion and garlic. | Cook them in butter until softened. | Add stock and simmer briefly. | Blend if desired, stir in milk or cream, and heat gently.

ingredients: salmon fillet; lemon; olive oil; garlic; salt; black pepper
instructions: Brush salmon with olive oil, lemon, garlic, salt, and pepper. | Heat a grill pan or oven. | Cook until the fish is opaque and flakes easily. | Serve with lemon.

ingredients: chicken; yogurt; cumin; paprika; garlic; flatbread; cucumber; tomato
instructions: Mix yogurt, garlic, cumin, and paprika; coat the chicken. | Cook chicken fully in a pan or oven. | Slice the chicken and chop the vegetables. | Wrap in flatbread with vegetables and a yogurt sauce.

ingredients: paneer; yogurt; bell pepper; onion; ginger-garlic paste; turmeric; chili powder; garam masala
instructions: Mix yogurt with ginger-garlic paste and spices. | Coat paneer and chopped vegetables in the marinade. | Thread onto skewers or spread on a tray. | Grill or bake until lightly charred, turning as needed.

ingredients: potato; cauliflower; onion; tomato; turmeric; cumin; coriander powder; oil
instructions: Cut potato and cauliflower into bite-sized pieces. | Cook cumin and onion in oil. | Add tomato and spices, then add the vegetables. | Cover and cook until tender, stirring occasionally.

ingredients: oats; milk or water; banana; berries; cinnamon; honey
instructions: Simmer oats in milk or water until creamy. | Slice banana and prepare berries. | Top the oatmeal with fruit and cinnamon. | Add honey if desired.

ingredients: banana; berries; yogurt; milk; granola
instructions: Blend banana, berries, yogurt, and a small amount of milk. | Add milk gradually to keep the mixture thick. | Pour into a bowl. | Top with granola and extra fruit.

ingredients: zucchini; bell pepper; broccoli; carrot; olive oil; garlic; lemon; salt
instructions: Cut vegetables into similar-sized pieces. | Toss with olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper. | Roast or grill until tender with browned edges. | Finish with lemon juice.

ingredients: bread; cheese; tomato; lettuce; butter or mayonnaise
instructions: Slice tomato and wash lettuce. | Layer cheese, tomato, and lettuce on bread. | Add butter or mayonnaise if desired. | Serve cold or toast until the cheese melts.

ingredients: tortillas; cheese; bell pepper; onion; corn; oil
instructions: Chop bell pepper and onion and cook until tender. | Place cheese and vegetables on half of a tortilla. | Fold and toast in a pan until crisp and the cheese melts. | Cut into wedges.

ingredients: noodles; peanut butter; soy sauce; lime juice; garlic; carrot; cucumber
instructions: Cook noodles and rinse briefly if serving cold. | Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, garlic, and a little water. | Toss noodles with the sauce. | Top with shredded carrot and cucumber.

ingredients: red lentils; onion; tomato; garlic; ginger; cumin; turmeric; stock or water
instructions: Rinse lentils thoroughly. | Cook onion, garlic, and ginger until fragrant. | Add tomato, spices, lentils, and stock or water. | Simmer until lentils soften, adding liquid if needed.

ingredients: bell peppers; rice; tomato; onion; beans; cheese; herbs
instructions: Cut the tops off the peppers and remove seeds. | Mix cooked rice with tomato, onion, beans, herbs, and some cheese. | Fill the peppers and place in a baking dish. | Bake until peppers soften and the filling is hot.

ingredients: black beans; corn; tomato; red onion; cilantro; lime juice; olive oil
instructions: Drain and rinse the beans and corn. | Chop tomato, onion, and cilantro. | Combine all ingredients in a bowl. | Dress with lime juice and olive oil; chill briefly if desired.

ingredients: bread; egg; milk; cinnamon; vanilla; butter
instructions: Whisk egg, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla. | Dip bread slices into the mixture. | Cook in butter over medium heat until golden on both sides. | Serve with fruit or a preferred topping.

ingredients: yogurt; banana; berries; oats or granola; nuts
instructions: Spoon yogurt into a bowl. | Slice banana and add berries. | Sprinkle with oats or granola and nuts. | Serve immediately.

ingredients: potato; peas; onion; tomato; ginger; garlic; turmeric; cumin
instructions: Dice potato and chop onion, tomato, ginger, and garlic. | Cook onion, ginger, and garlic with cumin. | Add tomato, turmeric, potato, peas, and water. | Cover and simmer until the potatoes are tender.

ingredients: noodles; garlic; butter; soy sauce; spring onion; sesame seeds
instructions: Cook noodles and drain, reserving a little cooking water. | Melt butter and gently cook minced garlic. | Add noodles, soy sauce, and a splash of cooking water. | Toss and finish with spring onion and sesame seeds.
